Your instructor

Troy MacDonald

“He will not put you anywhere you should not be.”

Born in Laguna, raised in a surf family, in the water here since before he could drive. He has been teaching this beach for over twenty years — long enough that the parents booking lessons now are people he taught as kids.

He is calm, he is patient, and that is most of why the first lesson works.

FAQ

The things everyone asks.

Do I need to know how to swim?

Yes. You should be comfortable in water over your head. You do not need to be a strong swimmer — the lessons run in waist-to-chest-deep water and Troy is next to you the whole time.

What do I need to bring?

A towel, sunscreen and something to wear under a wetsuit — a swimsuit or board shorts. The board, the wetsuit and the rash guard are included.

How old do you have to be?

Six and up. There is no upper limit — the oldest first-timer so far was seventy-one, and she stood up.

Will I actually stand up?

About 95% of first-timers do, usually inside the first forty minutes. The ones who do not are almost always trying to stand too early, and that gets fixed in the second lesson.

Where do we meet?

Thalia Street beach, Laguna Beach. Come down the stairs, turn left, and wait under the building overhang. Troy is the one with the boards.

What if the surf is too big or too flat?

Troy calls it the morning of and moves you at no charge. He has surfed this coast for twenty years — if it is not safe or not worth it, you will not be in it.

Is parking hard?

Street parking on Thalia and Glenneyre. Come fifteen minutes early on a summer weekend and you will be fine.

What is the cancellation policy?

Free up to 24 hours before. Inside 24 hours it is a reschedule rather than a refund, unless Troy is the one calling it off.
